title: FusionCLIP: Multimodal Contrastive Pretraining for Fusion Plasma Diagnostics
abstract: arXiv:2611.09493v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visible-light videos and multivariate diagnostic signals provide complementary observations of tokamak discharges. However, existing fusion pretraining methods primarily learn representations by reconstructing or predicting observations, leaving the correspondence between these modalities underexplored. Representation learning is further challenged by spatially localized plasma regions in video frames and substantial differences in diagnostic sampling rates. We propose FusionCLIP, a multimodal contrastive pretraining framework. A selective video encoder retains informative visual tokens, while a query-based time-series encoder integrates asynchronous diagnostic signals using their observation timestamps. Contrastive learning aligns representations of the two modalities. translated_title: FusionCLIP：面向聚变等离子体诊断的多模态对比预训练
translated_abstract: 可见光视频和多变量诊断信号为托卡马克放电提供了互补的观测手段。然而，现有的聚变预训练方法主要通过重构或预测观测数据来学习表征，而这些模态之间的对应关系尚未得到充分探索。视频帧中空间上局部化的等离子体区域以及诊断信号采样率的巨大差异，进一步给表征学习带来了挑战。我们提出了FusionCLIP，一个多模态对比预训练框架。其中，选择性视频编码器保留富含信息的视觉token，基于查询的时间序列编码器利用观测时间戳整合异步诊断信号，并通过对比学习将两种模态的表征对齐。我们构建了包含1307次EAST放电的EAST多模态诊断（EAST-MMD）数据集，并通过在三个（下游任务上）进行独立微调来评估模型（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出多模态对比预训练框架FusionCLIP，通过对齐可见光视频与异步诊断信号的跨模态表征，并构建包含1307次EAST放电的EAST-MMD数据集，推动聚变等离子体诊断研究。
en_tdlr: FusionCLIP is a multimodal contrastive pretraining framework that aligns visible-light videos with asynchronous tokamak diagnostic signals, supported by the new EAST-MMD dataset of 1307 EAST discharges, advancing cross-modal representation learning for fusion plasma diagnostics.
